* [https://web.archive.org/web/20070928014432/http://www.decipher.com/starwars/cardlists/swallcards.pdf Complete Card List] (Decipher PDF, archive 28 September 2007) — Dark Effect: We Shall Double Our Efforts!, Tatooine, R
|strategy=From:

[[We Shall Double Our Efforts!]] addresses a few of the difficulties in using a Build the [[Death Star II (Dark){{!}}Death Star II]] deck. First, it increases the direct damage by 1 per turn which can help you win a tight race at the end of a game. It also makes it more difficult for Light Side to make the killing blow by subtracting 2 from their [[That Thing's Operational]] total. That can give you extra turns to mount your starfighter defenses.

But perhaps most importantly, opponent's starships are maneuver -5. This helps in a few different ways. It gives you a real possibility of the movement destiny in the sectors destroying your opponent's starships. It also doubles the effectiveness of your starship weapons. With [[Desperate Counter]], if you have a TIE with a weapon, even a 6 maneuver [[Millennium Falcon{{!}}Falcon]] needs to draw a 4 to survive moving from the Capacitors. [[Major Mianda]] and [[Scythe 3]] or Lt. Hebsly and [[Scythe 1]] really shine here. Both ships allow you to move and then fire a starship weapon during your move phase, and both pilots make hitting starships easier. Combined with the -5 maneuver

automatic.

Combos: Operational as Planned + [[Desperate Counter]] + [[Combat Response]] + [[Major Mianda]] or [[Scythe 3]] + [[SFS L-s7.2 TIE Cannon]] + [[We Shall Double Our Efforts!]] = nearly impenetrable [[Death Star II (Dark){{!}}Death Star II]].<ref name="decipher-strategy">https://web.archive.org/web/20040811123219/http://www.decipher.com/starwars/cardlists/tatooine/dark/small/weshalldoubleourefforts.html</ref>
